d1277965-6bd9-457a-9a33-2879832b6d32.title: Shinmai Shimai no Futari Gohan
d1277965-6bd9-457a-9a33-2879832b6d32.description:
"But suddenly, I had a little sister. That was the problem."

After her father's remarriage, Sachi suddenly has a new stepsister, Ayari. At first, their interactions are awkward and very brief. However, they soon discover a shared love... of food? Sachi eventually discovers Ayari's passion for cooking, and the two step-sisters soon begin to bond over Ayari's delicious cooking, starting to overcome the barriers that had once kept them apart. While their parents are away on their honeymoon, they learn to cope with their differences and bond over a seemingly insignificant thing.

26fed225-c307-4af8-b47a-5bc603178552.title: Osana Robot to Abunai Hakase
26fed225-c307-4af8-b47a-5bc603178552.altTitle: The Little Girl Robot and the Perverted Professor
26fed225-c307-4af8-b47a-5bc603178552.description: New webcomic by the creator of Happy Happia. The story follows a perverted professor who falls in love with her creation, a young robot who truly despises her.

8a68d123-3c2b-4d79-8d71-65d9650350ab.title: Pink Lady
8a68d123-3c2b-4d79-8d71-65d9650350ab.description:
"Gyeo-Wul, an art student, is having trouble drawing. One day, she bumps into a handsome guy and takes his notebook by mistake. The notebook had drawings with an art style she is not used to and tries to draw better than him. But, it turns out that the guy knows who she is." ([Source](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=53027))  
  
*Parts 2-3 of the Epilogue and Volume 0 have yet to be scanlated.*

e64b54c4-5ef4-44d3-85db-09fe0d3e513c.title: Necromancer Academy and the Genius Summoner
e64b54c4-5ef4-44d3-85db-09fe0d3e513c.description:
Necromancers have built a name for themselves as fearsome practitioners of magic capable of dropping entire empires to their knees. Simon Follentia is a necromancer with incredible latent talent! After being scouted for the necromancer's academy, this genius is ready to be nurtured and taken to the next level. 

But could Simon's insane talents attract some unforeseen consequences?

e8c316a1-fc1a-4870-b418-29d5013db516.title: Shibou End o Kaihi Shita Gyaruge no Heroine-tachi ga Ore no [Nikkichou] o Yonde Himitsu o Shittarashii
e8c316a1-fc1a-4870-b418-29d5013db516.altTitle: The Heroines of a Gal Game Who Avoided the End of Death Read My [Diary] And Found Out My Secret
e8c316a1-fc1a-4870-b418-29d5013db516.description:
Para heroine berubah menjadi yandere berbahaya yang memuja diriku. Kenapa…?
“…Aku sudah tidak bisa melihat siapa pun selain dirimu. Mari bersama selamanya, ya?“
Aku yang terlahir kembali di dunia gal game, sedang dikejar-kejar oleh para heroine.
Namun, ada satu masalah.
“Maafkan aku. Jangan tinggalkan aku. Jangan membenciku.“
“Aku hanya akan mengabdi pada Satoshi-kun saja—sampai mati.“
“Satoshi-sama. Aku akan membalas budi baikmu yang telah menyelamatkanku seumur hidupku.“
Yaitu, semua heroine ini ternyata sakit!
Kenapa bisa mereka menjadi seperti ini!?
——Ngomong-ngomong, ke mana perginya [buku harian]-ku?

8f5bc041-86a5-483b-abbf-abc8dd093a76.title: Asayake Refrain
8f5bc041-86a5-483b-abbf-abc8dd093a76.description: Shin is a high school girl whose hobby is quietly uploading her original songs to the internet. When an unexpected character responds to one of her songs, her blinded youth suddenly picks up with a boom!

8461d3da-d14b-4a60-9a37-e4428fdda85e.title: Umareta Chokugo ni Suterareta kedo, Zense ga Daikenja Datta node Yoyuu de Ikitemasu ~Saikyou Akachan Daibousou~
8461d3da-d14b-4a60-9a37-e4428fdda85e.altTitle: The Strongest Baby Goes Wild!: Abandoned at Birth, but Living Easy Thanks to My Previous Life as a Great Sage
8461d3da-d14b-4a60-9a37-e4428fdda85e.description: Born to excellent parents, Leus is abandoned shortly after being born due to a mismeasurement of magical aptitude. However, he was a super baby who had the memory and ability of his previous life where he was touted as a Great Sage, and was able to fly, not to mention conversation and walking! Adventuring with the sacred dragon familiar, Lindworm, enjoy the life of a baby Sage who becomes a person and enjoys freedom!

24d78de2-df93-46c8-9dc5-91f997d2136d.title: Possessing a Murim Clan's Youngest Son
24d78de2-df93-46c8-9dc5-91f997d2136d.description:
The martial arts book that I discovered in the run down comic store said…  
  
"Will you… continue?"  
  
When I woke up, I thought I was a noble but… I became dirt poor again. I got the unlucky short end of the stick. The ruined Murim world too, also is a fool for pointing fingers at everyone for being insufficient.  
  
I have to take down the faceless demon to get home?  
Save the original story to yourself!  
Let's just grow stronger and help the main character.  
That's how I'll get out of this world!

fe7d5dbe-6f0a-42ed-9a83-67a4315bd3ee.title: Hunter Sesang-ui Jeongwonsa
fe7d5dbe-6f0a-42ed-9a83-67a4315bd3ee.description:
Ji-ha, the weakest labor-class hunter with neither skill nor fighting ability, made a living by running a store while holding the lowest hunter rank.

But one day, his life as a hunter changed when he entered a garden from a different dimension through his dream...

<You have obtained Friendly Plant Lv.1> <You have obtained Blessing of XXX Lv.1>

'I gained a skill just by planting one twig...?'

His unique adventure as the sole gardener in the hunter world begins.

c8da7141-f75b-45dc-9ab0-aad412fa50c8.title: March Story
c8da7141-f75b-45dc-9ab0-aad412fa50c8.description:
“Things that should not be touched by humans somehow find their way into this world. That’s why you should never, ever touch anything that is foreign.”  
Follow the adventures of March, a Syste Behard, who hunts ils– evil creatures that lurk in fascinating objects.  
  
Among the quiet villages and towns of 18th century Europe, demons known as the Ill hide within the most beautiful works of art, sparked to life by the torment of their creators. Attracted by their jewel-like allure, the unwary find themselves possessed by the Ill and driven to horrific acts of violence. Only the hunters of the Ciste Vihad can dispel the Ill.March is one such hunter, tracking the Ill from town to town to find the antiques that contain the demons before they can possess anyone. If the worst has come to pass, March's full powers are unleashed to battle the fiendish Ill. Born of tragedy, the artifacts all have their own tales to tell, as do each of their victims. But March's story may be the most tragic of all.

chapters.title: Memories the Color of Wind-blown Glass

f5badc31-60a8-4a47-9ef8-cd40ba62e473.title: Yamero Suki ni Natteshimau
f5badc31-60a8-4a47-9ef8-cd40ba62e473.description: Matsura is a calm, composed high school boy who's always lived his life putting up a front. He’s good at reading people and can easily see through them to their true nature, but for unknown reasons, he's constantly approached by Kyuuragi — a beautiful girl with twin tails who is part of the popular group! Whether it's intentional or not, her playful and cunning actions keep throwing him off, and before he knows it, Matsura is yelling, "Stop! I'm falling for you!"

6d5e015d-a5b1-4999-bbd2-95280fe33019.title: Haru no Regista
6d5e015d-a5b1-4999-bbd2-95280fe33019.description:
Once hailed as a soccer prodigy, high school girl Arai Haru transferred to a school far from her hometown, hoping to start a new life away from soccer. However, a new student, Osanai Satsuki, who admired Haru's past glory, appeared before her and declared her intention to join the Soccer Club, which is on the verge of disbandment. This is a girls' soccer story about a girl who gave up her dream and a girl who chases after it!
___
**What is a regista?**
The regista is a creative player who operates in front of the defense, almost always in a central position, and looks to get on the ball as often as possible. They are responsible for providing the link between defense and offense, and controlling the tempo of the game through their passing. The regista is also known as the deep-lying playmaker: they retain their deep position and dictate their team's play with their distribution. ([Coaches' Voice](https://www.coachesvoice.com/cv/what-is-a-regista-explained-jorginho-andrea-pirlo/))
